beats.speaker: Pip

beats.speaker: Riss
beats.text: Riss, a quick-tongued opportunist who finds the joke in any disaster, speaks. "The rules are softer than you think."
At a cliff edge, you find what you came for, and it is not what you expected it to be.

beats.speaker: Pip
beats.text: Pip — the one who fled when you called — comes back, eyes low. "I ran. I know I did. Will you trust me to stand with you this time?"

beats.speaker: Riss
beats.text: Riss, who stood beside you earlier on the road, arrives with exactly what is needed. "You helped me once. Let me return it."
Far off, a single light answers a light you did not know you'd shown.
